explication: GitDiagram turns a GitHub repository into a streamed, interactive architecture diagram, with linked source paths and PNG/Mermaid export. The main journey is repository page to diagram generation and display; separate product branches let users browse diagrams and create, watch, and render repository explainer videos. The graph also shows preview persistence and sponsorship redirects. Generation internals are represented only where sampled route code supports the calls; unsampled client and subsystem wiring is intentionally limited.
